# Tables

| Element     | Left aligned | Center aligned | Right aligned |
| :---------- | :----------- | :------------: | ------------: |
| Headings    | yes          |      H1/H2     |             6 |
| Code blocks | dark bg      |      copy      |            42 |
| Callouts    | 4 types      |      icon      |           100 |
| Tables      | zebra        |     stripes    |          1000 |

The table above verifies zebra striping on even rows, per-column alignment (left/center/right), and horizontal-only borders.
